what: Google Chrome's Modern Web Guidance 1.0 (v1.0.0 on Nov 10): "Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices." It installs for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Copilot CLI, and includes a legacy-scan command for older codebases. It has been public since March 23.
OpenAI's official Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK finds vulnerabilities and drafts fixes on request. It has been public since July 13.

HeyGen's hyperframes: "Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents." It turns HTML, CSS, media and seekable animations into deterministic MP4s, from the CLI or from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents via skills (npx hyperframes skills update or the Claude Code plugin). Handy for POC/demo videos for clients from HTML your agent writes, without an editor — it renders HTML to video; it does not record a live product demo.

Alibaba's qz-browser-agent is a local-first browser agent for automation, research and extraction. It has been public since mid-October and runs as an extension in the Chrome or Edge you're already signed into, using your existing logins for automation and long click flows — real signed-in access is the feature and the risk. Bring your own model; it returns tables, files and reports. Grok Bot, Claude Code and Codex can hand it tasks via CLI/MCP (including npx skills add alibaba/qz-browser-agent -g).

Cloudflare's security-audit-skill is the skill that started Cloudflare's vulnerability harness. It runs a six-phase audit (map, hunt, challenge, record, verify, report), writes schema-checked findings.json with findings labeled confirmed, needs_validation or rejected, and has those findings re-checked by fresh agents.
note: Cloudflare's write-up: Build your own vulnerability harness.

what: Vercel Labs' agent-desktop, which just shipped v1.1, gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots: it reads the OS accessibility tree on macOS, Windows and Linux and returns JSON refs the agent clicks or types on, then reads the UI again to check. There's no model inside, and it ships as a CLI and a C library, handy for automating legacy desktop apps that have no API.

Microsoft's TokenEconomizer makes coding agents cheaper to run in repos you work in often, without changing the agent: it learns repo facts, drops tools that go unused and steps in when a turn gets stuck in a failure loop. It works with Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI and Pi, and the authors report 18.4–30.9% lower mean cost on SWE-Bench across five agent–model combinations.

Claude or Codex reads your codebase and draws an interactive, plain-English map of it, matching each web request to the endpoint that answers it, even across separate repos. A built-in health check flags keys left in code and endpoints with no sign-in, handy before a customer demo.
Agent skills for building native Mac apps in Swift and SwiftUI, from idea to your Dock, with no Xcode GUI. It has 21 skills (per the README) and works as a Claude Code and Codex plugin.
t3dotgg's (Theo's) own everyday agent skills for Claude Code and Codex, in one repo. FDEs can copy a working setup instead of building one from scratch.

proyecto26's 22 agent skills for system design (caching, sharding, load balancing, API design and more) that reason from a customer's real constraints instead of memorized diagrams. Handy for FDEs to run before an architecture call.
Matt Pocock's ready-made slash-command skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, straight from his own .agents directory. FDEs and SEs can drop them in instead of writing prompts from scratch.
A large curated toolkit for Claude Code: agents, skills, slash commands, plugins, hooks, rules, templates and MCP configs in one repo.
Graphify turns a codebase, plus its docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. It ships as a /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI.
install:
uv tool install graphifyy
graphify install

what: Beacon by Asymptote Labs captures session history across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ other harnesses and turns it into reusable knowledge.
note: Asymptote Labs raised $5.5M in a seed round led by Tower Research Ventures, announced Oct 20, 2026 (source).
install:
brew tap asymptote-labs/tap
brew install beacon

what: Cloudflare's official agent skills. They teach your coding agent how to build and deploy on Cloudflare, so it stops guessing at things like wrangler config. The plugin also adds Cloudflare's MCP server.
